title: Welcome to my website
text:
Welcome! This is where I’ll share:

Educational content — research methods, statistics, and how-to guides

Data science posts & news — tutorials in R and Python, and updates worth knowing

title: Research Opportunities
text: Want to join a research project? Below are the projects currently open. Each one lists what’s needed and how to apply.

title: Research Opportunities

Example project: Systematic review & meta-analysis
Status: 🟢 Open · Deadline: 2026-12-31 · Spots: 4
About the project: A short description of the research question and what the team will do.
Roles needed:

Literature screening (title/abstract and full text)
Data extraction
Risk-of-bias assessment

Requirements: Medical student or graduate, basic English writing, ~5 hours/week.
Authorship: Contributors who complete their tasks are included as co-authors.
